What caused the floods in Nepal

fun_fact: Nepal saw its most devastating floods in history on Aug 27. At least 1287 people are dead and more than 5000 are still missing. The flash floods were triggered by a glacial collapse and the destructive path of the floods destroyed several towns, villages, hydro electric projects etc. It also completely destroyed Gyirong Port, the border crossing that is the main gateway for pilgrims heading to Mount Kailash.
